corpus_shape: Firstmate task knowledge captured from durable outcome manifests and scout reports (docs/gbrain-capture.md). Roughly a quarter of the documents are manifest-only ship records whose whole content is a title, an outcome line, and a pull-request URL; the rest are long investigation reports.

questions.question: Why did the ArkNode NVMe controller wedge a third time, and what was actually writing to the drive?
Did ArkNode paper trading stop running after 17 June, or was it running and finding no eligible trade?
What does a 0xDEADBEEF readback at VME address 0x65D001D0 mean on the DFD card?
In the BZ-SIM RTL reconciliation, which copy of meg_fm_top_rev1.vhd is the damaged one, and what should not be pushed to the build server?
Should ark-robinhood CI run on the CT110 self-hosted runner?
What was the verdict on the ark-robinhood research-graph plan, and what made the replacement gate unsafe?
questions.note: Two documents cover this work - a review and a prototype - so either is a correct first result.

questions.question: How many home-manager deprecation warnings are there on the dotfiles flake, and which block produces them?
What produces the nvim lazy-lock.json startup error, and did it reproduce on the live machine?
Why does the DFD frequency register read back zero while pulse width and CW still work?
Was the cursor and agy harness branch safe to land, and what were the must-fix findings?
questions.note: Five near-duplicate documents cover one review thread, so any member of that family is a correct first result. This question measures whether the family is found at all, not which revision ranks first.

questions.question: What blocks the ark-hermes-agent pytest suite from running on CT110?
Is the ark-robinhood repository ready to be worked on from CT110, and what are the headline gaps?
Should firstmate adopt Matt Pocock's to-tickets skill for filing issues, and was any setup already done?
What should firstmate borrow from Matt Pocock's planning workflow, and what should it not import?
Which option was recommended for bounding the trading-signal probe, and what did it measure as costing per probe?
What order of operations was recommended for the ArkNode nginx proxy manager hardening, and why was the approved order reversed?
Where should upstream reconciliation live for /updatefirstmate, and how is the merge landed on the fork?
Which pull request fixed the spawn regression that pinned CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to the evidence store?
questions.note: A manifest-only document: its entire body is a title, an outcome line, and a pull-request URL.

questions.question: Which pull request delivered the usage storage and Claude and Codex usage collectors for the dashboard?
questions.note: A manifest-only document, and one of six sibling dashboard stories, so it also tests discrimination inside a near-duplicate family.

questions.question: How must the tea CLI be invoked for the Gitea-hosted projects, and what does fm-pr-check.sh do with a Gitea URL?
questions.note: The only captured note rather than a task, which is why it is in the set.
